skill_name: List the various stages of product design.
workflow: The stages of product design include research, ideation/exploration, concept development, design iteration, prototyping/testing, implementation, and maintenance. Research involves collecting data and ideas to inform the design process. Ideation/exploration involves creating and exploring various design ideas.
